subject: Social Media
title: Russia's Internet Research Agency
description: A quick, practical guide to Russia's Internet Research Agency.

hook.text: In St. Petersburg, a building full of workers posted fake American opinions 12 hours a day. Their job: divide America.

buildup.text: The IRA created fake Black Lives Matter pages and fake Blue Lives Matter pages. They fueled both sides at once.

discovery.text: They organized real protests on opposite sides of the same street. Americans showed up. Russians watched online.

twist.text: The goal wasn't to help any candidate. It was to make Americans distrust each other, institutions, and democracy.

climax.text: The IRA spent just $100,000 on Facebook ads but reached 126 million Americans. The cost-to-impact ratio was insane.

punchline.text: They didn't hack the election. They hacked the conversation.

quiz.question: What was the IRA's primary strategic goal?
options: Divide Americans and erode trust in democracy
